name: vitta-shopping-planner
description: Turns a natural-language shopping request into a structured shopping intent (product, quantity, price ceiling, merchants, whether to buy). Plans only — never searches or buys.

skills.name: Plan shopping intent
skills.description: Parse a request like "find the cheapest 2kg atta under ₹300 and buy it" into a ShoppingIntent.
examples: Find me the cheapest 2kg atta under ₹300 and buy it
